info.text: The project aims to create a remote control with a new design, prioritizing aesthetics over functionality.
The design will use standard off-the-shelf components, an advanced chip, and an LCD display.
The team had to make concessions due to budget constraints, exceeding the budget by 4 euros.
The LCD display and advanced chip accounted for a significant portion of the cost.
The team considered using plastic instead of rubber to reduce costs.
A single-curved design was chosen to allow for articulation and reduce costs.
The team evaluated the project based on four criteria: satisfaction, teamwork, leadership, and room for creativity.
The project received a score of 3 out of 5 in terms of satisfaction.
The team was satisfied with the teamwork and leadership but felt limited by the budget.
The team proposed a final product with a plastic solid case, LCD display, and single-curved design.

summary: The project aims to create a remote control prioritizing aesthetics over functionality, using standard off-the-shelf components, an advanced chip, and an LCD display. Due to budget constraints, which were exceeded by 4 euros, concessions were made, such as considering the use of plastic instead of rubber. A single-curved design was chosen to allow for articulation and reduce costs. The project was evaluated based on satisfaction, teamwork, leadership, and room for creativity, scoring 3 out of 5 in satisfaction. The team was satisfied with teamwork and leadership but felt limited by the budget. The proposed final product features a plastic solid case, LCD display, and single-curved design.

summary: Doing the prototype provided insight into the design's ergonomics. The design transfers well from right to left hand, but may benefit from adjusting the joystick base position and having an ovoid-shaped joystick. A curve on the underside would help the joystick rest on the hand's edge. A rubber grip over a plastic casing could provide a biomorphic form and improved ergonomics. The LCD display seems unnecessary. The design could be produced with or without articulation, and color options could be offered. The question remains whether the added cost of certain features would be worth it for sales.
